senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Ignorant, unwise, foolish.
2 Fearful, timid.
3 Unsteady, figuratively or literally.
m. (-लः)
1 A raft, a float.
2 The name of a Muni, the supposed author of some medical works.
E.
भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and the final changed to ल.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A raft, a float.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.
